lessons.goal: 追蹤配方更新，區分必要條件與口味偏好。

questions.evidence: Cooking club messages: Tomorrow we will make banana sandwiches. The first recipe included peanut butter, but the club kitchen has asked us to use only ingredients supplied for this session. The final list is bread, bananas, and plain yogurt. Please do not bring extra toppings.
questions.explanation: 第一段提供最後食材清單。
options: Bread, bananas, and plain yogurt.
Bananas, apples, and peanut butter.
Bread, peanuts, and chocolate sauce.
Yogurt, chocolate, and extra toppings.
questions.prompt: What are the final supplied ingredients?

questions.evidence: Lily: I dislike yogurt. Can I leave it out of my own sandwich? Teacher: Yes. The yogurt is optional, and nobody has to use it. Keep the serving spoon in its own bowl so students can choose without mixing ingredients.
questions.explanation: 老師明確允許不加優格。
options: Only if she brings peanut butter.
Only after the teacher takes a photo.
Yes, it is optional.
No, every sandwich needs it.
questions.prompt: May Lily omit yogurt from her sandwich?

questions.evidence: Sean: An old photo in the group still shows chocolate sauce. Teacher: That photo is from last month. It does not show tomorrow's recipe. I have pinned the new ingredient list above it and added tomorrow's date.
questions.explanation: 日期協助辨認適用明日的版本。
options: To distinguish tomorrow's instructions from the old photo.
To change when last month's session occurred.
To make chocolate sauce mandatory.
To count how many sandwiches Lily eats.
questions.prompt: Why does the teacher add the date to the pinned list?

questions.evidence: Lily: I dislike yogurt. Can I leave it out of my own sandwich? Teacher: Yes. The yogurt is optional, and nobody has to use it. Keep the serving spoon in its own bowl so students can choose without mixing ingredients.
questions.explanation: 後文說沒有人一定要使用。
options: Required for every person.
Stored on a different day.
Available to choose but not required.
Brought only from home.

lessons.story:

Lily: I dislike yogurt. Can I leave it out of my own sandwich? Teacher: Yes. The yogurt is optional, and nobody has to use it. Keep the serving spoon in its own bowl so students can choose without mixing ingredients.

Sean: An old photo in the group still shows chocolate sauce. Teacher: That photo is from last month. It does not show tomorrow's recipe. I have pinned the new ingredient list above it and added tomorrow's date.
